direction_output.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the [output](https://esphome.io/components/output/) to use for the direction state of the fan. Default is empty.

*See also: [Binary Fan](https://esphome.io/components/fan/binary#configuration-variables)*

oscillation_output.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the [output](https://esphome.io/components/output/) to use for the oscillation state of this fan. Default is empty.

*See also: [Binary Fan](https://esphome.io/components/fan/binary#configuration-variables)*

output.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the binary output component to use for this fan.

*See also: [Binary Fan](https://esphome.io/components/fan/binary#configuration-variables)*

**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the binary [Output Component](https://esphome.io/components/output/) to use for this light.

*See also: [Binary Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/binary#configuration-variables)*
